message.content:
If you mean **art collaborations in 2023**, the search results point to a few notable examples, especially **Co/LAB 2023** in Los Angeles and **Art Collaboration Kyoto 2023** in Japan.[1][5]

- **Co/LAB 2023** was an annual international emerging-artists collaborative project at Torrance Art Museum, pairing four artist-run galleries from around the world with four Southern California artist-run galleries for four collaborative exhibitions.[1]
- The featured pairings included **Kalashnikovv Gallery (Johannesburg) with Wonzimer (Los Angeles)**, **Fosforita (Madrid) with Durden and Ray (Los Angeles)**, **Supermarket (Stockholm) with 515**, and **Space One (Seoul) with Tiger Strikes Asteroid (Los Angeles)**.[1]
- **Art Collaboration Kyoto 2023** took place at the Kyoto International Conference Center from **October 28 to 30, 2023**.[5]
- More broadly, the search results also show **art-science collaborations** in 2023, such as the Dunn Lab’s collaboration on a **Bioscience** publication about how organisms prepare food, with artist Eleanor Quist Olson creating a painting inspired by the work.[2]
